Special intervention: the nobles' introduction — the only scene scheduled at cycle zero (the very first cycle).

Special intervention: dragon-knight second encounter — when this scene sits in a cycle, the phase-start check launches the dragon-knight allied interventions (Tarcus's if he is available, Silgur's if she is available).
Director scene: act 1 ending — fires on the dragon-knight ultimatum victory, then switches the game to act 2.

Special intervention: kingslayer second encounter — when this scene sits in a cycle, the phase-start check launches the kingslayer allied interventions (Gwendan's if she is reformed and available, Ursula's if she is available, not highly corrupted and has died at least once).
Director scene: act 2 ending — fires on the kingslayer ultimatum victory, then switches the game to act 3.
Director scene: act 3 ending / game finale — fires on the emperor ultimatum victory to end the game.
